grammar.pattern: 层 / 封 / 件 / 条 / 位
grammar.purpose: Match the classifier to the thing or person
grammar.explanation: 层 counts floors or layers; 封 counts letters; 件 counts items of clothing and some matters; 条 counts long flexible things such as scarves; 位 respectfully counts people. Compare 一件衣服 and 一条围巾. 位 does not replace every classifier: a letter is 一封信, not 一位信. Use a recipient’s own name if it is available; the classifier does not tell you their gender.

commonMistakes.why: Use 封 for a written letter; 条 is not its classifier.

grammar.pattern: 送 + recipient + gift / 送给 + recipient + gift
grammar.purpose: Keep two objects and the destination distinct
grammar.explanation: With giving verbs, the person can come before the thing: 我送你一本书. 给 can mark the recipient: 我送给你一本书. 我给你一本书 also works. 送到学校 states the destination, not the person receiving the gift. Not every verb takes two bare objects: use 把这封信交给她 or 将这封信交给她, rather than transferring the pattern to 看. These examples teach the common giving patterns, not a universal rule for all verbs.

lines.zh: 包裹先放下吧。你写了几封信？
lines.py: bāo guǒ xiān fàng xià ba . nǐ xiě le jǐ fēng xìn ?
lines.en: Put the parcel down first. How many letters did you write?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 两封。一封给照顾我的朋友，一封给老师。
lines.py: liǎng fēng . yī fēng gěi zhào gù wǒ de péng you , yī fēng gěi lǎo shī .
lines.en: Two. One for the friend who looked after me and one for the teacher.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那位朋友住三层，对吗？
lines.py: nà wèi péng you zhù sān céng , duì ma ?
lines.en: That friend lives on the third floor, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，但这个包裹送到学校。地址在笔记本里。
lines.py: duì , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào . dì zhǐ zài bǐ jì běn lǐ .
lines.en: Yes, but this parcel goes to the school. The address is in my notebook.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 纸和笔在这儿。你准备了什么礼物？
lines.py: zhǐ hé bǐ zài zhèr . nǐ zhǔn bèi le shén me lǐ wù ?
lines.en: The paper and pen are here. What gifts did you prepare?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 一条围巾、一件衣服，还有一套笔记本和笔。
lines.py: yī tiáo wéi jīn , yī jiàn yī fú , hái yǒu yī tào bǐ jì běn hé bǐ .
lines.en: A scarf, an item of clothing, and a set of notebooks and pens.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哪一份送给老师？
lines.py: nǎ yī fèn sòng gěi lǎo shī ?
lines.en: Which gift is for the teacher?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 笔记本和笔。我送朋友围巾，衣服留给自己。
lines.py: bǐ jì běn hé bǐ . wǒ sòng péng you wéi jīn , yī fú liú gěi zì jǐ .
lines.en: The notebooks and pens. I give my friend the scarf and keep the clothing for myself.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她接受了吗？
lines.py: tā jiē shòu le ma ?
lines.en: Has she accepted it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她说谢谢，还说看了信很感动。我也感谢她的帮助。
lines.py: tā shuō xiè xiè , hái shuō kàn le xìn hěn gǎn dòng . wǒ yě gǎn xiè tā de bāng zhù .
lines.en: She thanked me and said she was moved by the letter. I am grateful for her help too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 信要交给谁？
lines.py: xìn yào jiāo gěi shéi ?
lines.en: Who should receive the letter?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 交给老师。先确认收件人，再寄，别只看楼层。
lines.py: jiāo gěi lǎo shī . xiān què rèn shōu jiàn rén , zài jì , bié zhǐ kàn lóu céng .
lines.en: Hand it to the teacher. Confirm the recipient before mailing; do not check only the floor.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我写了两封信，一封给朋友，一封给老师。
lines.py: wǒ xiě le liǎng fēng xìn , yī fēng gěi péng you , yī fēng gěi lǎo shī .
lines.en: I wrote two letters, one to my friend and one to my teacher.

lines.zh: 朋友前几天照顾我，我想感谢她。她看了信，说很感动。
lines.py: péng you qián jǐ tiān zhào gù wǒ , wǒ xiǎng gǎn xiè tā . tā kàn le xìn , shuō hěn gǎn dòng .
lines.en: My friend looked after me a few days ago, and I wanted to thank her. She read the letter and said she was moved.

lines.zh: 我送给她一条围巾。那件衣服不是礼物，留给我自己。
lines.py: wǒ sòng gěi tā yī tiáo wéi jīn . nà jiàn yī fú bù shì lǐ wù , liú gěi wǒ zì jǐ .
lines.en: I give her a scarf. The item of clothing is not a gift; I keep it for myself.

lines.zh: 给老师的礼物是一套笔记本和笔，每人一份，不用猜价格。
lines.py: gěi lǎo shī de lǐ wù shì yī tào bǐ jì běn hé bǐ , měi rén yī fèn , bù yòng cāi jià gé .
lines.en: The teacher’s gift is a set of notebooks and pens: one gift each, with no need to guess the price.

lines.zh: 朋友住三层，但这个包裹要送到学校。学校地址在我的笔记里。
lines.py: péng you zhù sān céng , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ yào sòng dào xué xiào . xué xiào dì zhǐ zài wǒ de bǐ jì lǐ .
lines.en: My friend lives on the third floor, but this parcel goes to the school. The school address is in my notes.

lines.zh: 我先把包裹放下，拿纸和笔写地址，再检查收件人。
lines.py: wǒ xiān bǎ bāo guǒ fàng xià , ná zhǐ hé bǐ xiě dì zhǐ , zài jiǎn chá shōu jiàn rén .
lines.en: I put the parcel down, take paper and a pen to write the address, and then check the recipient.

lines.zh: 接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。
lines.py: jiē dào fú wù tái de tōng zhī hòu , lǎo shī kě yǐ qù ná . wǒ qǐng péng you bǎ lìng yī fēng xìn jiāo gěi tā .
lines.en: After receiving the service desk’s notice, the teacher can collect it. I ask my friend to hand her the other letter.

lines.zh: 别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。
lines.py: bié ren bù fāng biàn jiē shòu lǐ wù , yě kě yǐ shuō bù yòng le . gǎn xiè bù yí dìng yào kào sòng dōng xi .
lines.en: Someone who finds accepting a gift inconvenient can decline it. Gratitude does not have to depend on giving things.
